# cb:b404

> Two structural types carry derived beliefs. type:compound = descriptive synthesis of facts from deps; the claim states what the deps together describe. type:implication = prescriptive derivation from deps; the claim states what must be done or must be true based on the deps. A belief whose claim has both shapes is represented as two beliefs (one per type), linked via deps.
